newsitem.title: SPAIN: Lisbon air cargo up 20 percent in February.
newsitem.headline: Lisbon air cargo up 20 percent in February.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Lisbon airport rose 20 percent in February to 8,716 tonnes, the Portuguese airports authority ANA said. This takes the total in the first two months of the year to 16,251 tonnes, a 14.6 percent increase on the same period 1996.
Passenger numbers at Lisbon were 3.8 percent higher than the same month a year earlier at 376,595.
The number of aircraft movements fell by 2.4 percent in the month to 5,474.

Cargo business at Porto, the country's second biggest air freight airport, was up 59.3 percent in February at 2,927 tonnes, putting its accumulated total at 5,087 tonnes. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
